subject: [PATCH v9 14/32] mm: handle PMD swap entries in fork path

2026-11-05.patch_summary: This patch addresses an issue where PMD swap entries are not handled correctly in the fork path, leading to duplicated and unreferenced slots. The patch modifies the copy_huge_pmd function to duplicate PMD swap entries by creating new references to the source slots, clearing the exclusive marker on the source entry, and updating the mm counter accordingly. It also adds error handling for GFP_ATOMIC allocation failures in the fork path.
